_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.name: Yummy Country-Style Ribs
_similar.description: A flavorful and tender country-style ribs recipe marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, orange juice, and spices, then grilled to perfection.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all marinade ingredients except the ribs in a bowl. Mix well.
Place ribs in a shallow dish and cover with the marinade. Refrigerate for 24 hours, turning meat occasionally.
Remove ribs from marinade and place on barbecue grill. Cook over low heat for about 1 hour, brushing with marinade occasionally.
Close barbecue hood and continue cooking until done, about 15 minutes more.

_similar.keywords: country-style ribs, marinated ribs, BBQ ribs

_similar.name: Nacho Salad
_similar.description: A spicy nacho salad with ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and nacho chips, topped with a creamy dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (or mozzarella), shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Drain excess fat.
Add spices and water to the beef mixture. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes.
In a large salad bowl, mix together the shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and crushed nacho chips.
In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise, relish, ketchup, and hot pepper sauce.
Pour the dressing over the salad and add the cooled meat mixture.
Toss the salad to combine all ingredients and serve.

_similar.keywords: nacho salad, spicy salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Ginger Noodle Soup
_similar.description: A flavorful and aromatic Asian-inspired soup featuring pork, ginger, and rice stick noodles in a savory chicken broth.
recipeIngredient: 1 pork chop, sliced into small pieces

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan brown pork over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce and soy sauce. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add rest of ingredients, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Garnish with green onion and coriander.

_similar.keywords: ginger noodle soup, Asian soup, pork soup
